selection_authority: MAI-01 completed_verified and strict MAI order selects MAI-02 after the ecosystem/format/license/authority survey.
objective: Define the vendor-neutral canonical MapAsset, Tile, TerrainSet, ObjectAsset, Module, Battlemap, Layer and Placeable/package model, including identity, dimensions, transforms, anchors, grid metadata, elevation, variants, animation, dependencies and source/license provenance, without implementing later coordinate/autotile/import/resolver/workbench/runtime tranches.

predecessor_contract.rule: MAI-02 must consume the MAI-01 survey without making any surveyed vendor/editor canonical, infering rights, collapsing semantic requirements into chosen art, or silently discarding unsupported source metadata.

acceptance_profile.canonical_entities: Define stable vendor-neutral identities and relationships for MapAsset, Tile, TerrainSet, ObjectAsset, Module, Battlemap, Layer, Placeable and package/source records.
acceptance_profile.geometry_metadata_boundary: Represent dimensions/transforms/anchors/grid/elevation/variant/animation/dependency metadata as map-asset data without turning coordinates/artwork into World/combat truth.
acceptance_profile.provenance_license: Carry source/checksum/license/evidence/import lineage and unresolved permissions explicitly.
acceptance_profile.incomplete_pack: Preserve semantic requirement versus selected art separation plus exact/cross-pack/manual/placeholder/unresolved outcomes.
acceptance_profile.unsupported_metadata: Provide an explicit preservation/reporting path for source metadata not yet represented; no silent discard.
acceptance_profile.validation: Future owner Continue must resolve exact schema evidence, governed-start MAI-02, add focused validation and exact-head governed gates before merge.

nonauthorization: MAI-02 implementation before future owner Continue
World/combat identity inferred from artwork or coordinates
automatic asset substitution without explicit resolver authority
migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: Next owner Continue must freshly verify then-current canonical AIOC/application heads, re-read MAI-01 completed survey evidence plus MAI program/backlog, resolve the exact MAI-02 schema/authority evidence set, then governed-start MAI-02 only. Do not create an implementation branch from selected_not_started state.
